title: Multilateral Phronimos's engine and its first case
about: The multilateral engine, a program around the API's composition of the diplomacy domain with nomos and tyche, compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/multilateral-phronimos/multilateral/; and the first open case, the Migration Multi-Partner Trust Fund as its publisher records it in IATI (ODC-PDDL), read from d-portal into data/cache/products/multilateral/.
